conventions.cost_unit: log2 of arithmetic operations over F_{2^131} as counted by [HKPYY20] Theorem 3.2; the O~ cofactor is dropped; the 3^{kappa m^2} and m! factors are KEPT because at n = 131 they are not constants a reader can ignore

field_facts.X131_minus_1_over_F2: (X + 1) * Phi_131(X) with Phi_131 irreducible of degree 130

linearized_F2_coefficient_census.note: subfield polynomial of F_2; |V| = 2, useless as a factor base

linearized_theorem1_bound.note: [EP21] Section 4.4 says kappa < 1.5 would give alpha_beta > 1 at beta = 3/4; from alpha_beta = 1/(2 kappa beta) that requires kappa < 2/3, not 1.5. Recorded as a discrepancy in the source text, not adjudicated here.
